cases.title: 有界隐式 PD：有限正力限切换、释放与重新饱和
cases.observation: 已按公开通知契约完成正反力限切换，全部预设物理门槛通过。物理门槛与严格 PADMM 收敛诊断分开记录。 最大力矩参考误差 2.66e-06 N·m；A 每次切换在同一步采用新限值，状态在通知前后不跳变；A/B 收敛标记比例 100%/100%，仅适用于本小驱动场景，不覆盖旧高增益场景。
cases.limitations: One finite-positive limit update contract on one CPU Y hinge, no route topology change, no zero/inf/sentinel, no unnotified update, no gain/mode change, contacts, GPU, graph capture, multiworld or general convergence claim. Strict convergence statistics are diagnostics and may fail even if physical gates pass.
cases.association_scope: Only finite positive effort limit is varied via public notify; gains, mode, solver budget and timestep fixed. No zero/infinite or route-allocation change coverage.
